hero-needle.alt: A bundle of pale straw on cream paper, with one gold needle drawn out of it and a navy thread trailing from its eye.
hero-needle.prompt: A small, neat bundle of pale golden wheat straw stalks lying diagonally from lower left to upper right across a sheet of warm cream cotton paper, seen from slightly above at a 30 degree angle. One polished gold sewing needle lies among the straws, pulled a little way out of the bundle so it stands apart, catching a clean line of light along its length. A fine deep navy linen thread runs through the needle's eye and trails off in a loose, elegant curve onto the empty paper on the right. Subject occupies the central two thirds, with calm empty paper around it so the image survives square, 4:5 and 4:3 crops. Editorial still-life photograph for a Swiss design monograph. Materials: warm cream uncoated cotton paper, natural undyed linen, pale golden wheat straw, a single polished gold sewing needle, fine deep navy linen thread. Light: soft diffused north-facing window light from the upper left, calm early-morning Geneva light, gentle long soft shadows, no hard highlights. Camera: medium-format, 100mm macro lens, f/8, crisp focus on the subject, true-to-life colour, low saturation, subtle fine natural film grain. Palette restricted to cream #F3ECDD, linen #EDE5D3, straw #D9BE7E, gold #C29A3E and navy ink #1A2136. Minimal, precise, orderly composition with generous negative space, Swiss grid sensibility.
